preconditions.description: Input must contain two integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 20) and m (0 ≤ m ≤ 400) representing the number of nodes and edges, respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= n and 1 <= int(u) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for v, u in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge must consist of two integers vi and ui (1 ≤ vi, ui ≤ n) representing connected nodes.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' if any(all(node in path for node in range(1, n + 1)) and len(path) == n for path in permutations(range(1, n + 1)) if all((path[i], path[i + 1]) in {(int(v), int(u)), (int(u), int(v))} for i in range(n - 1))) else 'No'
postconditions.description: Output 'Yes' if and only if there exists a Hamiltonian path (a path that visits each node exactly once) in the graph; otherwise, output 'No'.
